claimed_root_cause: allow_open_registration defaults True and register only 403s when is_production and that flag is false, so a production deploy that omits the flag keeps anonymous owner-JWT minting.
title: Open registration defaults on and mints owner JWTs
description: POST /auth/register is public. The production close-gate requires both ENVIRONMENT=production and ALLOW_OPEN_REGISTRATION=false. The setting defaults true, .env.example leaves it true, and DEPLOY.md treats closing signup as a post-bootstrap step. A successful call creates an owner tenant and returns an access JWT. The web UI always exposes Register.

trace.description: allow_open_registration Field default True; production_must_be_safe does not require it false.
After creating Account, owner User, and General sale, register returns create_access_token for that owner.

validation_plan.local: In the OS sandbox with dummy data, POST /auth/register under default settings and expect 200 plus access_token. Monkeypatch is_production True while leaving allow_open_registration at default True and expect 200 plus access_token. Then set allow_open_registration False with is_production True and expect 403. Do not call any deployed host.
validation_plan.deployment: Owner reads only the Railway API service variables ALLOW_OPEN_REGISTRATION and ENVIRONMENT. If ENVIRONMENT is production/prod and the flag is unset or true, treat the issue as live. Do not POST /auth/register against production.

blockers: No OS-enforced sandbox is available (empty allowlist env, no-network namespace, read-only target, trusted parent-side no-follow promotion), so TestClient register calls were not executed.
Live Railway ALLOW_OPEN_REGISTRATION and ENVIRONMENT were not observed; this run must not probe the public API or create accounts.

evidence.description: 403 only if is_production and not allow_open_registration.
ALLOW_OPEN_REGISTRATION defaults True with comment to set true only to bootstrap.
production_must_be_safe rejects weak SECRET_KEY, SQLite, and empty CORS_ORIGINS in production, but does not require allow_open_registration false.
Deploy table says default true and to set false after the first real account.
Public login page posts /auth/${mode}, which is /auth/register when the always-visible Register tab is selected.
create_access_token signs sub/account_id/role with HS256 and long default TTL.
